captions.detailed: A low-poly, faceted sphere with three orthogonal cylindrical holes passing completely through its center. The outer surface is highly geometric and blocky due to the low fragment count of the sphere. The intersecting holes create a hollowed-out internal chamber visible through the openings on the X, Y, and Z axes.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, low-poly hollow sphere with three orthogonal intersecting holes. The design should allow the user to easily adjust the outer sphere size and the inner hole diameter, with the cylindrical cutouts automatically scaling to pass completely through the sphere along the X, Y, and Z axes.
captions.factory: The design uses a helper function `r_from_dia` to convert diameters to radii. A custom module `rotcy` is defined to create centered cylinders rotated by 90 degrees along specified axes. A `difference` operation is then performed to subtract three instances of these cylinders (aligned along the X, Y, and Z axes respectively) from a central `sphere` primitive.
